_doc: The one list of deployment names (provisional; rename here, then fix the code that reads the name). release/names.test.mjs checks the other lists against it.

cloudflare_vars.FCM_PROJECT_ID: Firebase project id the Worker sends FCM pushes to
cloudflare_vars.APNS_TOPIC: APNs topic: the iOS app bundle id
cloudflare_vars.APNS_KEY_ID: id of the APNs auth key (.p8)
cloudflare_vars.APNS_TEAM_ID: Apple developer team id that owns the APNs key
cloudflare_vars.VAPID_SUB: VAPID subject (mailto:), also the ops contact address
cloudflare_vars.SES_REGION: AWS region of the SES account that sends sign-in codes
cloudflare_vars.MAIL_FROM: From address of sign-in code mails
cloudflare_vars.SES_CONFIG_SET: SES configuration set name for sent mails
cloudflare_vars.GOOGLE_AUD_WEB: JSON list of Google OAuth client ids accepted from web flows
cloudflare_vars.GOOGLE_AUD_NATIVE: JSON list of Google OAuth client ids accepted from the apps
cloudflare_vars.APPLE_AUD_WEB: Apple Services ID accepted from web sign-in
cloudflare_vars.APPLE_AUD_NATIVE: iOS app bundle id accepted from native Apple sign-in

cloudflare_secrets.CODE_SECRET: HMAC key for mailed sign-in codes
cloudflare_secrets.SES_ACCESS_KEY_ID: AWS access key id for SES
cloudflare_secrets.SES_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: AWS secret access key for SES
cloudflare_secrets.APPLE_SIGNIN_KEY_ID: id of the Sign in with Apple key
cloudflare_secrets.APPLE_SIGNIN_KEY_P8: Sign in with Apple key (.p8 content)

local_keys.release_cert_sha256: list of Android release signing cert SHA-256 fingerprints (assetlinks, App Links)
local_keys.chrome_extension_id: Chrome Web Store extension id (site /turnstile framing)
local_keys.chrome_dev_key: Chrome manifest public key for dev builds (keeps the store id)
local_keys.vapid_public_key: Web Push VAPID public key baked into the site, extensions and Android
local_keys.google_web_client_id: Google web OAuth client id used by Android sign-in
local_keys.ios_development_team: Apple developer team id for iOS signing
